about: Application connection plumbing (foundation/04, decision 011): one connection string per plane, and only ever two. A serving process connects to each plane separately, and cross-plane assembly happens in application code, never in SQL (test/two-plane-split.test.mjs proves no SQL path spans them; the FDW/dblink ban is foundation/07). Both strings carry the serving role identity_app (SELECT+INSERT only, migration 0002), never owner or migration credentials. checks/serving-credentials.mjs fails a serving tree holding those. Values are the loopback development containers from docker-compose.yml; real credentials are a managed-Postgres concern behind the founder gate in plans/ORDER.md.
